title: Rubrica (Copies Black)
summary: The red words that mark what matters are painted by the browser and vanish on copy — reproduction carries only the scribe's black text.
mechanism: CSS Custom Highlight API paints render-only Range highlights that are absent from the DOM, textContent and the clipboard.
references: Johannes Gutenberg, 42-line Bible (c. 1455) — spaces left blank for hand-added rubrics
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
